name: drupal/wordpal
description: Converts a WordPress block theme into a Drupal CMS site editors change in Drupal Canvas or Display Builder.

suggest.drupal/canvas: Required by wordpal_canvas and wordpal_canvas_runtime, the Canvas target.
suggest.drupal/display_builder: Required by wordpal_display_builder and wordpal_display_builder_runtime, the Display Builder target.
suggest.drupal/ui_patterns: Required by the Display Builder target.
suggest.drupal/ui_skins: Required by the Display Builder target.
suggest.drupal/pathauto: Installed by every Site recipe a conversion writes.
